releases.name: v1.5.0 — Pure OpenCode V2 TypeScript + OpenTUI Release (opencode-lazy-se)
releases.body:
## v1.5.0

- Migrate the entire codebase to strict TypeScript (`.ts` / `.tsx`) with compiled `dist/` output, declaration files (`.d.ts`), dual-target OpenTUI/Solid emission (`scripts/emit-tui.mjs`), and root entry shims (`index.js`, `tui.js`).
- Publish package under npm name **`opencode-lazy-se`** while preserving internal plugin ID `opencode-lazy-skill-engine` for seamless mesh interoperability.
- Add `LazySidebar` OpenCode V2 TUI sidebar extension (`./tui`) and typed `opencode-lazy-skill.stats` RPC contract (`./rpc`) reporting `version`, `catalogVersion`, `ready`, `skills`, `native`, `vault`, `local`, `global`, `conflicts`, and `conflictIds`, with automatic stale-snapshot reset on workspace directory changes.
- Add Universal OpenCode V2 Plugin Mesh bridge (`src/bridge.ts`, `BRIDGE_REVISION = "2.3.0"`) for zero-dependency interoperability with `opencode-hi`, `opencode-guardian`, and `opencode-smart-questions`.
- Detect multi-vault, native-vs-vault, native-vs-native, and `maxSkills`-capped skill ID conflicts in `Catalog.refresh()` and `scanVaults()`.
- Handle empty frontmatter (`---\n---`), multiline indented scalars, and indented YAML comments (`  # comment`) cleanly in `parseFrontmatter()`, and improve doubled-consonant stemming in `variants()`.
- Align documentation (`README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/COEXISTENCE.md`, `docs/QUALITY.md`, `docs/assets/verification-overview.svg`) with `opencode-guardian` and `opencode-smart-questions` design, covering Global, Project-Local, `.opencode/plugins/` Symlink, `file://`, and Remote TUI (`cli.json`) installation modes (`179 / 179` passing tests).

## v1.4.5

### Highlights
- **Startup & Event Cache Invalidation:** Subscribes to `skill.updated` and `agent.updated` via `ctx.event.subscribe` and invalidates the catalog cache on `ctx.skill.transform` replay to eliminate the 30s stale-cache race with late-loading plugins.
- **OpenCode V2.3.2 Contract Alignment:** Supports optional `Skill.Info.description` in `normalizeNative()` via frontmatter/name fallback, enforces `bindExplicit` allowlist boundaries in `selectBindings()`, and checks `abortIfNeeded(context)` after async steps.
- **Vault & Tool Hardening:** Scans vault roots highest-priority-first in `scanVaults()` so global vaults cannot starve project skills under `maxSkills`; tightens `lazy_skill_search` / `lazy_skill_info` input validation; exposes `semanticSkipped` in `lazy_skill_plan`; detects nested plugin `synthetic`/`internal`/`autoContinue` metadata flags.

### Verification
- `npm test`: `166 / 166` passing (`node --test`)
- `npm run check`: passing
- `opencode v2.3.2 --standalone` packed-artifact sandbox check: passing
